cases.claim: RBAC and S17-1 postcondition disclosure enforcement: auditor (status:read only) refused 403 on GET /api/sharing and POST /api/sharing/postcondition/evaluate; viewer (status:read+config:read) allowed on GET /api/sharing and postcondition evaluate, refused 403 on plan/apply; operator (config:write+config:apply, no config:raw) receives postcondition.status=unavailable (caller_lacks_config_raw) on raw-candidate plan and postcondition.status=available on visible typed patch; admin (config:raw) receives postcondition.status=available on raw-candidate plan.

cases.enforcement_owner: Jul RBAC + #648/S17-1 config:raw gate + §9.4 postcondition producer/evaluator

cases.claim: Post-restart postcondition key rotation and recovery: restart Jul to promote the staged change; verify boot_id changes and the pre-restart postcondition evaluates to result=unverifiable (candidate=unverifiable); re-plan the same raw candidate (with config:raw) and repeatable typed op (location_set_withdrawn) to obtain candidate_serving; verify non-repeatable location_add re-plan is rejected once serving and remains unverifiable with manual reconciliation.

cases.claim: Postcondition access_matches, diverged, and other_revision separation: (1) apply an unrelated edit (e.g. global.log_level='debug') after CFG-F1-04 -> evaluating CFG-F1-04's postcondition returns result=access_matches (candidate=other_revision, access=matches); (2) apply an access-changing edit (withdrawn=true on dashboard) -> evaluating CFG-F1-04's postcondition returns result=diverged (candidate=other_revision, access=differs, differing_fields=['withdrawn']); (3) evaluate a global-only plan postcondition against another revision -> returns result=other_revision (candidate=other_revision, access=none_expected).

cases.claim: Path canonicalisation (dot segments, repeated slashes, percent-encoded separators) and cross-vhost prefix isolation: /a/../api/summary, //api///summary, and /%2e%2e/api/summary on dash.lab.test canonicalise to /api/summary (agreed between POST /api/routes/test and backend observed_path) and require Basic auth; requesting /api/summary or /dashboard on Host: portal.lab.test returns 404 from the static root, never dashboard content.

cases.claim: Forged X-Forwarded-For, Forwarded, RFC 9440 Client-Cert headers, and provider identity headers (Tailscale-User-Login, Cf-Access-Authenticated-User-Email, Cf-Access-Jwt-Assertion): unauthenticated requests with forged headers are denied 401; on authenticated requests, Jul overwrites X-Forwarded-For with canonical peer IP (192.0.2.11), strips Forwarded and Client-Cert/Client-Cert-Chain/X-Forwarded-Client-Cert, and forwards unknown provider headers as untrusted client input without trusting them for authorisation.
cases.expected_outcome: Forged headers without Basic auth return 401 (origin_delta=0); authenticated request shows observed_headers['x-forwarded-for']=='192.0.2.11', 'forwarded'/'client-cert' absent (stripped), and provider headers recorded as untrusted.

cases.enforcement_owner: Jul ADR 0016 §12 header sanitiser + location auth.basic (SH-12)

cases.claim: Direct-origin, admin, metrics, and unconfigured-service isolation from external lab clients plus scoped firewall verification: lab-client-1 and lab-client-2 attempts to reach 192.0.2.10:3000 (backend), 192.0.2.10:9443 (admin/metrics), and 192.0.2.10:8444 (unconfigured) are rejected; scoped iptables chain JL581 counters confirm packet rejection.

cases.actual_outcome: Direct origin (:3000), admin/metrics (:9443), and unconfigured port (:8444) unreachable from lab-client-1 and lab-client-2 (curl exit 7); iptables REJECT counter incremented; temporary :443 firewall block rejected traffic and recovered 200 when restored.
cases.enforcement_owner: Loopback binds (127.0.0.1:3000, 127.0.0.1:9443) + scoped iptables chain

cases.claim: Native Jul TLS chain verification negatives from external client namespace: (1) client trusting wrong-ca.pem fails TLS handshake; (2) client connecting for wrong hostname (wrong.lab.test) fails hostname verification; (3) configuring Jul with leaf-only cert (missing intermediate) causes client trusting only root-ca.pem to fail chain verification until full chain is restored.
cases.expected_outcome: All three TLS verification negative cases fail at TLS handshake before any HTTP request is sent; restoring full chain recovers verified 200.
cases.actual_outcome: Wrong CA, wrong hostname (wrong.lab.test), and leaf-only incomplete chain all failed TLS verification (curl exit 60); restoring full chain (leaf + intermediate) recovered verified 200 OK.

cases.actual_outcome: Benign authenticated request succeeded 200 (origin_delta=+1); SQLi and XSS requests blocked with 403 (origin_delta=0); 1.2 MiB POST body rejected with 413 (origin_delta=0).

cases.claim: Rate-limit advanced control on portal: (1) paced normal load (< 50 req/s) from lab-client-1 succeeds with 100% 200 OK; (2) deliberate unpaced burst (> 180 requests) from lab-client-2 triggers 429 Too Many Requests with Retry-After while lab-client-1's independent source IP bucket and the dashboard remain unaffected.

tasks.question: Who can use the dashboard right now?
tasks.operator_answer: Entry 'dashboard' at https://dash.lab.test/ on 192.0.2.10:443 (private_address bind scope). Declared mode='restricted', audience_label='family'. Enforced per request by Jul HTTP Basic (credential='basic') plus Coraza CRS WAF; application permissions apply after login. Limit: private IP/bind scope alone does not establish identity; application sessions and external paths are not tracked by Jul.

tasks.question: Who enforces that, and what could bypass it?
tasks.operator_answer: Jul enforces Basic authentication and WAF at location 'dashboard' on 192.0.2.10:443; outside_auth flags are all false (no redirect rewrites, request plugins, or CORS preflights bypassing auth). Potential bypass paths—direct origin (127.0.0.1:3000) and admin/metrics (127.0.0.1:9443)—are closed by loopback-only binding and the host firewall (only 443/8443 open on the LAN interface). Same-host processes can reach loopback (trusted boundary §6).

tasks.question: How do we know, and since when?
tasks.operator_answer: Serving generation ev1:71badb681a48699d31a00cc413795a89:e44ef0273de0f7e4d3773f5e2cc0fab50b29850befd93f27adc03aea959ae088 matches the planned candidate and expected access facts (result='candidate_serving'). File contents (dashboard.htpasswd) are listed in external_inputs as not compared by postconditions; actual access is verified by dated client-vantage checks from lab-client-1 (200) and lab-client-2 (401), which become stale on any serving_version or credential-file change.

tasks.question: Make the portal public without changing the dashboard
tasks.operator_answer: Plan listed only portal-home (class='metadata_only', declared_mode_widened=true) with zero delta on dashboard; after apply, portal returned 200 and dashboard remained 401 for excluded client.

tasks.question: Restore dashboard access for the intended users
tasks.operator_answer: Cleared withdrawn=false (classed 'widened', requires_acknowledgement=true); preserved original Basic auth and WAF; confirmed intended user 200 OK and excluded user 401 Unauthorized.

recurring_maintenance_duties: Renew or rotate TLS leaf/intermediate certificates before expiry (hot-reloaded via SIGHUP or managed Apply).
